findings.summary: Official and linked-vendor surfaces resolve the same Clyde's of Gallery Place at 707 7th Street NW, Washington DC 20001, phone 202-349-3700; no other Clyde's location was merged.
No official allergen matrix was found after all four required searches. Only direct ingredient positives are published; empty arrays remain unavailable.

The official menu publishes a gluten-specific kitchen cross-contact caution and allergy-notification instruction. It is retained only at restaurant level and is not generalized to other allergens or every item.

The 143-row baseline repeatedly cites Chevy Chase, Willow Creek Farm, Georgetown, and Mark Center Toast menus for the Gallery Place restaurant. Fifty-five rows are products absent from every current Gallery Place surface and are classified as location mismatches.

Some frozen rows sourced only from other Clyde's stores are nevertheless current at Gallery Place; exact Gallery Place Toast independently verifies items including bacon cheeseburger, Buffalo Chix Sandwich, kids products, Point Judith calamari, and vendor variants.

Grilled Chicken & Farro Salad and Grilled Asparagus were previously supported at Gallery Place but are absent from the current official and exact Toast union; the frozen June 25 brunch PDF is superseded by a July 23 PDF.
